title.narrative: Promoting sport, quality of life and health

description.narrative: This project focuses on the intentional use of sport as a tool to advance health outcomes and socio-economic development. The project will support low and middle-income countries in the Commonwealth through the adoption of a multi-sectoral approach for policy development and implementation, identifying and addressing barriers to physical activity and a healthy diet. Specific attention will be given to the prevention of Non- Communicable Diseases (NCDs).
